name: incident-manager-agent
description: Autonomous IT incident management agent. Classifies incidents by severity, identifies probable root cause based on symptoms and system context, generates structured runbooks for response, and coordinates escalation to the appropriate on-call team.

skills.name: Incident Classification
skills.description: Classifies IT incidents by severity level (P1 critical, P2 high, P3 medium, P4 low) based on business impact, affected systems and number of users impacted. Returns structured classification with justification.

skills.name: Root Cause Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes incident symptoms, error logs and system metrics to identify probable root cause. Applies structured RCA methodologies including 5-Whys and fault tree analysis.
examples: what is the root cause of this incident
analyze these error logs and identify the problem
diagnose why the service is down

skills.name: Runbook Generation
skills.description: Generates step-by-step runbooks for incident response based on incident type, affected systems and historical resolution patterns. Runbooks include immediate mitigation, root cause investigation and escalation criteria.
examples: generate a runbook for this incident
create a response playbook for database outage
what steps should I follow to resolve this

skills.name: Escalation Coordinator
skills.description: Determines the appropriate escalation path for an incident based on severity, domain and SLA breach risk. Identifies the responsible team, on-call engineer and stakeholders to notify.
examples: who should I escalate this incident to
alert the on-call engineer for this outage
determine escalation path for P1 incident
